intro.zh-TW: MaiCoin 旗下的 MAX 虛擬貨幣交易所。使用邀請連結註冊，買進你的第一個虛擬貨幣。
intro.en: MaiCoin's MAX crypto exchange. Sign up with this referral link and buy your first crypto.

description.zh-TW: MAX 是 MaiCoin 旗下的虛擬貨幣交易所，使用者可以在上面買賣虛擬貨幣。這個邀請連結已經包含邀請碼 89225d4a；進入註冊頁後，若有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，請自行填入這組代碼。註冊前先看一下網址列，確認網域與 MAX 官方網站一致，再填寫個人資料。帳號的申請條件與服務內容，請以 MAX 官方網站的說明為準。
description.en:
MAX is MaiCoin's crypto exchange, where users can buy and sell crypto. The referral link on this page already contains the referral code 89225d4a. Once the sign-up page opens, check whether it has a referral code field; if the field is empty, type the code in yourself.

Before you enter any personal details, look at the address bar and confirm that the domain matches the official MAX website. For account requirements and service details, refer to the information on the official MAX website.

q.zh-TW: MAX 邀請碼要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the MAX referral code?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼 89225d4a 已包含在本頁的邀請連結中，請用連結開啟註冊頁。若註冊頁有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，就在該欄位填入 89225d4a。
a.en: The referral code 89225d4a is already part of the referral link on this page, so open the sign-up page through the link. If the page has a referral code field and it is empty, enter 89225d4a there.

q.zh-TW: 邀請碼無法使用怎麼辦？
q.en: What if the referral code is not accepted?

a.zh-TW: 先確認填入的是 89225d4a，並依原樣輸入（注意英文大小寫）；再確認網址列的網域與 MAX 官方網站一致，然後重新從本頁的邀請連結進入。若仍然無法使用，請參考 MAX 官方網站的說明。
a.en: Check that you entered 89225d4a exactly as shown, including upper and lower case. Then check that the domain in the address bar matches the official MAX website, and open the sign-up page again from the referral link on this page. If it still does not work, refer to the information on the official MAX website.
